definition: An oilfield well-intervention method using hydraulic equipment to move pipe into or out of a pressurized well.
entry_text: An oilfield well-intervention method using hydraulic equipment to move pipe into or out of a pressurized well.
example: A specialist team evaluates whether controlled well intervention requires a snubbing unit.
label: Hydraulic snubbing
sense_note: The oilfield sense is intended; confirm against hydraulic damping or restraint in other domains.
